jobs.title: Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Professional Engineer
jobs.description:
Benefits:

401(k)
Bonus based on performance
Competitive salary
Dental insurance
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Profit sharing
Tuition assistance

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator (Construction)
jobs.description:
KEEP PROJECTS MOVING. CONNECT THE DETAILS. BUILD YOUR CAREER.

Ironcore Construction is growing—and we’re looking for a highly organized Pod Assistant Project Manager / Project Coordinator to support our Project Executive and project teams across multiple multifamily construction projects.

This role is built for someone who sees the big picture but never loses track of the details. You’ll help connect project teams, Accounting, leadership, and other stakeholders while maintaining visibility into the financial, administrative, compliance, and closeout requirements that keep projects moving.

If you’re organized, proactive, comfortable working across multiple projects, and know how to turn information into action, we want to meet you.

Who We Are

Ironcore Construction is a California general contractor and full-service construction and development company specializing in multifamily residential and affordable housing.

Our Culture Is Built Around Six Core Values

Integrity | Vision | People | Safety | Innovation | Continuous Improvement

Building Homes. Creating Community.THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Pod Assistant Project Manager / Project Coordinator, you’ll support the Project Executive across a portfolio of projects while serving as a central coordination point for project teams.

You’ll maintain visibility into project health, financial deliverables, documentation, compliance, permitting, funding, and closeout while identifying items that need follow-up or escalation.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who can organize information, anticipate needs, hold people accountable, and keep multiple projects moving forward.

What You’ll Do

Support the Project Executive and coordinate priorities across assigned projects.
Maintain pod-level action logs, commitments, milestones, and recurring project reviews.
Track project health, forecasts, schedules, procurement risks, changes, and key issues.
Coordinate monthly project reporting and prepare consolidated information for leadership reviews.
Track pay applications, draws, invoices, budget reconciliations, and other financial deliverables.
Coordinate follow-up between Project Managers, Accounting, and the India Accounting Team.
Monitor RFIs, submittals, Procore compliance, and other critical project documentation.
Track subcontractor insurance, licensing, bonding, lien waivers, certified payroll, and compliance exceptions.
Monitor permit, inspection, Certificate of Occupancy, and other jurisdictional milestones.
Track funding requirements, lender/ownership comments, and outstanding documentation.
Maintain project closeout tracking, including O&Ms, warranties, as-builts, lien releases, retention, and final pay applications.
Identify overdue items, project risks, and cross-project issues and escalate them to the appropriate project or executive leadership.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience in construction project coordination, project engineering, or assistant project management preferred.
Multifamily or commercial construction experience strongly preferred.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage priorities across multiple projects.
Working knowledge of project financials, RFIs, submittals, contracts, change management, and closeout.
Experience with Procore and Microsoft Office.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to analyze project information and identify missing, late, or high-risk items.
Strong follow-through and attention to detail.
Comfortable coordinating across Project Managers, Accounting, subcontractors, and leadership.
Proactive, accountable, and able to escalate issues appropriately.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Ironcore offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support our employees and invest in their future.

Competitive Base Salary

$110,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits are available to eligible full-time employees, effective the first of the month following 30 days of employment.

401(k) + Company Match

Employees become eligible after three months of continuous employment. Ironcore currently matches 100% of the first 3% contributed and 50% of the next 2%.

3 Weeks of Paid Time Off

Employees accrue 120 hours (3 weeks) of PTO annually, increasing to 160 hours (4 weeks) after five years of continuous employment.

Paid Sick Leave

Paid sick leave is provided in accordance with California law and Company policy.

Employer-Paid Insurance

Eligible full-time employees receive Company-paid long-term disability coverage and $10,000 in basic life insurance.

WHY IRONCORE?

See the whole picture. Gain visibility across multiple projects instead of working within a single project silo.

Work directly with leadership. Partner closely with the Project Executive and project teams while supporting critical business and project decisions.

Build broad construction knowledge. Develop experience across project controls, financials, compliance, documentation, permitting, funding, and closeout.

Make an impact. Your ability to identify issues, drive follow-up, and keep information organized directly supports successful project delivery.

Grow with us. Build the operational and project-management experience needed to advance as Ironcore continues to grow.

READY TO BUILD WHAT’S NEXT?

If you’re highly organized, proactive, comfortable managing competing priorities, and have the follow-through to keep multiple project teams moving, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and Build Homes. Create Community. Build Your Career.

jobs.title: Senior Financial & Data Analyst (FinOps) - Hanover, Maryland
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Senior Financial & Data Analyst (FinOps) roles at Ciena sit at the intersection of technology, finance, and data-driven decision-making. This position plays a pivotal role in running Information Technology (IT) like a business—bringing transparency, predictability, and accountability to IT and cloud investments. With direct exposure to senior leaders across IT, Finance, and Cloud teams, this role offers the opportunity to influence strategy, optimize spend at scale, and help Ciena continue to lead with both innovation and humanity.

How You Will Make An Impact

Establish financial transparency across run, grow, and transform IT spend through accurate forecasting, variance analysis, and standardized key performance indicators (KPIs)
Drive measurable cost optimization and value realization across applications, infrastructure, vendors, and cloud consumption
Own IT contract and renewal financial governance, enabling data-driven decisions to renew, renegotiate, optimize, or exit agreements
Partner with Finance Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Accounting to ensure strong accruals, capitalization practices, and audit readiness
Design executive-ready dashboards and analytics that serve as a single source of truth for IT and cloud financial performance
Advance Cloud Financial Operations (FinOps) accountability through tagging discipline, consumption insights, and commitment management
Improve financial and operational processes through standardization, automation, and KPI-driven maturity tracking

The Must Haves

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
5+ years of experience in financial analytics, data analytics, or Financial Operations (FinOps) roles
Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial analysis, and variance management
Advanced experience working with large datasets using tools such as Excel, Structured Query Language (SQL), Power BI, or similar
Proven ability to translate complex metrics into clear insights for senior and executive stakeholders
Experience supporting Information Technology (IT) or technology-focused organizations
Hands-on cloud cost management or FinOps experience across providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

Nice To Haves

Experience managing IT vendor contracts, renewals, and financial negotiations
Exposure to automation or data integration initiatives that reduce manual financial effort
Familiarity with cloud tagging strategies and chargeback or showback models
Experience building KPI frameworks to track process efficiency and operational maturity
Knowledge of enterprise financial systems or IT service management platforms

Pay Range

The annual pay range for this position, in the United States of America, is $89,300.00 - $142,700.00 USD..

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location:
Marietta, OH

Job Type:
Full-Time, Direct Hire

Starting Salary:
$60,000/year, with higher compensation available based on experience

Industry Requirement:
Power distribution industry experience required

Position Overview

We are seeking an organized and detail-focused Manufacturing Project Coordinator to support configure-to-order (CTO) and quick-ship programs. This position coordinates orders from entry through shipment while working closely with production, supply chain, engineering, quality, and logistics teams.

Responsibilities

Coordinate CTO and quick-ship orders from entry through shipment and closeout
Review sales orders for accuracy, completeness, and configuration requirements
Track material availability, production, testing, and shipping milestones
Maintain accurate project and order information in ERP and project management systems
Work with production, supply chain, quality, and shipping teams to keep orders on schedule
Provide customer order updates and communicate schedule changes
Identify at-risk orders and escalate potential delivery issues
Assist with logistics, shipping documentation, and customer-specific requirements
Prepare internal and customer-facing project status reports
Support improvements to order tracking and scheduling processes

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred
1-3 years of experience in project coordination, order management, customer service, inside sales support, or manufacturing operations
Experience working with ERP systems and project tracking tools
Strong organization, multitasking, communication, and follow-through skills
High attention to detail and commitment to accurate data
Ability to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Strong problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in electrical, industrial, or electromechanical manufacturing
Familiarity with configure-to-order (CTO) or make-to-order manufacturing
Experience with power distribution products or industrial equipment
Shipping and logistics coordination experience
CAPM certification or interest in pursuing a project management certification

What We Offer

Comprehensive benefits package
Career growth and professional development
Support for professional certifications and advancement
Collaborative manufacturing environment

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
